content.hebrew: אֵין כֵּאלֹהֵֽינוּ, נוֹרָא עֲלִילוֹת;
content.english: None is like our God, who is awesome in deed;

content.hebrew: הֵקִיר בְּדָתוֹ מֵי בְאֵר, וְאִשֵּׁר מְסִלּוֹת.
content.transliteration: Heḳir bedato mē ve’er, ve’ish’sher mesillot.
content.english: With His law, He makes the well’s water flow, and sturdies the roads.

content.hebrew: רוּחוֹ תְאַשֵּׁר לְעַמּוֹ, לְתוֹר הַמַּעֲלָה לַעֲלוֹת,
content.transliteration: Ruḥo te’ash’sher le‘ammo, letor hamma‘ala la‘alot,
content.english: His spirit makes His people firm, to attain spiritual perfection,

content.hebrew: נִשְׁמָתָן לְהִתְעַדֵּן בְּתוֹרוֹת מִמֶּֽנּוּ אֲצוּלוֹת.
content.english: So that their souls will take pleasure in the teachings extended by Him.

content.hebrew: פָּקַח עֵינֵיהֵם בְּמִצְוֹתָיו, לֵאוֹר בְּאוֹר חַיֵּי תְהִלּוֹת.
content.transliteration: Paḳaḥ ‘enehem bemitsvotav, le’or be’or ḥayyē tehillot.
content.english: He opened their eyes through His commandments, so that they would be enlightened in the light of a life [full] of praises.

content.hebrew: יִחֵד יוֹם לַשָּׁנָה, בְּקוֹל הֲמֻלּוֹת,
content.english: He uniquely designated one day of the year, with a roaring voice;

content.hebrew: הוּא יוֹם כַּפָּרָה וְיוֹם מְחִילוֹת.
content.english: It is a day of atoning, and a day of pardoning.

content.hebrew: בּוֹ בַיּוֹם נִכְנַס כֹּהֵן בְּחֻקּוֹת מֻגְבָּלוֹת,
content.transliteration: Bo vayyom nikhnas kohen gadol beḥuḳḳot muḡbalot,
content.english: On that very day, the priest enters [the holy of holies], according to restrictive laws,

content.hebrew: לָבוּשׁ בַּדִּים – בִּגְדֵי חֵן וּמְעִילוֹת.
content.english: Dressed in linen clothes—beautiful garments and cloaks.

content.hebrew: שָׂמוֹ כְּמַלְאֲכֵי מָרוֹם, לְמַלֵּא מִשְׁאָלוֹת.
content.english: [God] made him like the angels on high, to fulfill responsibilities.

content.hebrew: בָּא בְמִקְדָּשׁ, בְּדַם פָּר וְשָׂעִיר וְעֹלוֹת,
content.transliteration: Ba vemiḳdash, bedam par vesa‘ir ve‘olot,
content.english: [The priest] would come into the place of holiness, with the blood of an ox and a goat, and burnt offerings,

content.hebrew: מְכַפֵּר בַּעֲדוֹ וּבְעַד בֵּיתוֹ אֲשָׁמִים וּמְעָלוֹת.
content.transliteration: Lekhapper ba‘ado uv‘ad beto ashamim um‘alot.
content.english: To atone on his behalf, and on behalf of his family, for [their] sins and acts of sacrilege.

content.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן עַל שְׁנֵי הַשְּׂעִירִים גּוֹרָלוֹת,
content.english: He would place lots upon the two goats,

content.hebrew: לַיוי וְלַעֲזָאזֵל, לָשֵׂאת נִסְתָּרוֹת וְנִגְלוֹת.
content.english: For Adonai and For ‘Azazel, to carry away concealed and revealed [sins].

content.hebrew: וּמְלוֹא הַמַּחְתָּה גַּחֲלֵי אֵשׁ, וּקְטֹֽרֶת לְהַעֲלוֹת.
content.transliteration: Umlo hammaḥta gaḥalē esh, uḳtoret leha‘alot,
content.english: [He would take] the firepan, in its fullness, with fiery coals, and cause incense [smoke] to ascend.

content.hebrew: וְכִפֶּר עַל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ, וּשְׁלֹשָׁה וִדּוּיִים שְׂפָתָיו מְמַלְּלוֹת,
content.transliteration: Vekhipper ‘al haḳḳodesh, ushlosha vidduyyim sefatav memallelot,
content.english: He would atone for the holy place, and his lips would speak three confessions,

content.hebrew: וְהַזָּאוֹתָיו בְּהֵיכָל וְלִפְנָי, כְּפוּלוֹת.
content.english: And his sprinklings would be double, in the hekhal and deep inside.
content.comments: Hekhal. The space inside the Temple but outside the holy of holies.

content.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה עוֹלָתוֹ וְעֹלַת הָעָם, עַד כַּלּוֹת.
content.english: He would perform his burnt offering, and the people’s burnt offering, until completion.

content.hebrew: כְּלַל הַמִּצְוֹת בְּסוֹד הַיְסוֹד נִפְעָלוֹת.
content.english: The totality of the commandments are performed in the mystery of the foundation.

content.hebrew: וְכֵן הִזְהִיר לְעַמּוֹ: כָּל־עֶרְוָה אֲסוּרָה בִּלְתִּי לְגַלּוֹת.
content.transliteration: Vekhen hizhir le‘ammo: Kol ‘erva asura bilti leḡallot.
content.english: Moreover, [God] warned His people not to uncover any forbidden nakedness.

content.hebrew: שֹׁמְרֵי הֲלִיכוֹת הוֹד, מִשְׁאָלוֹת לְמַלֹּאת,
content.english: Those who observe the ways of splendor fulfill responsibilities,

content.hebrew: קהל: עוֹנִים בְּפֶה אֶחָד בְּשִׁיר תְּהִלּוֹת.
content.english: Cong. They respond, [as if] with one mouth, with songs of praise.

content.hebrew: חזן: כִּֽי־בָנָ֣ה יו֣י צִיּ֑וֹן נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּכְבוֹדֽוֹ:
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Ki vana Adonai tsiyyon nir’ah bikhvodo:
content.english: Cantor: For Adonai has built Zion; He has appeared in His Glory. (Ps. 102:17)

content.hebrew: קהל: בָּר֥וּךְ כְּבֽוֹד־יו֖י מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ:
content.english: Cong. Blessed is Adonai’s Glory from His place. (Ezek. 3:12)
